title: A test: Mining-skill work for Nebula-born miners: ore of Alrakis Commerce Vein into storage at Cargo Lanes Freight Depot (one jump)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 03:33 UTC (orders ENT-071, P6 and O1, O2; rules F3, F22, F23, F37). Eight Nebula newborns waited at 03:32 UTC with Khambalia full and Bunda at its floor (fill.py status miner). Alrakis Commerce Vein read 92,279 copper and 38,835 iron, richness 25 and 32 (table fields, a read under 10 minutes old at 03:33 UTC), 3 jumps from Haven and one from Cargo Lanes Freight Depot, a Nebula station with storage (table stations, lanes); no pirate line for Alrakis or Cargo Lanes in data/intel/sightings.jsonl (read 03:33 UTC). The same work as gather-khambalia-crystal-market-train, which met F37: the Mining skill at one jump each way, the ore kept in storage. min_left iron 15,000 keeps a floor. A new field: one ship until three results (F37); lift_to 6 lets fill.py widen it after that. requires.empire nebula. 2026-11-23 05:20 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 1 -> 6. 2026-11-23 05:22 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 6 -> 12. 2026-11-23 05:29 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 12 -> 14. 2026-11-23 08:53 UTC (Zero): requires.max_jumps 8. Twelve Nebula-born miners crossed to Central Nexus to store at 08:31 UTC (store-hold-central-nexus, now capped at 14 jumps); standing work has no empire reach, so from Nexus they would fly 20 jumps back for this copper and iron. At 8 jumps a ship that stands in Voidborn space works there (orders P6: the main corridors) and the ships at home keep the field.
